peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 15.5% above its local comparables; 118 of 130 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (52.0): 3.1 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 198 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 13). Context, not scored: resales in 29.2% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $2,610,000 ($1,988 psf, 1,130–1,334 sq ft; 5 resales, Aug 2024–Jul 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,722 psf (range $1,299–2,080); 15.5% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $349,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Paya Lebar MRT about 630 m, Dakota MRT about 840 m; closer than 195 of 662 similar developments (the same as 7). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 7 within 2 km; nearest Haig Girls' School about 770 m; more than 547 of 662 similar developments (the same as 73). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 10 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 300 m), more than 426 of 662 similar developments (the same as 86); nearest hawker centre Haig Road Market And Cooked Food Centre about 320 m; nearest park Marine Parade Rd Park about 1,440 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Haig Road Market And Cooked Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (The Continuum, 208 new sales, about 240 m; Grand Dunman, 72 new sales, about 720 m; Tembusu Grand, 11 new sales, about 740 m; Ardor Residence, 13 new sales, about 750 m; Verdé Joo Chiat, 9 new sales, about 760 m; Emerald of Katong, 2 new sales, about 860 m; Koon Seng House, 6 new sales, about 950 m; Claydence, 8 new sales, about 1,150 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 493 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 476 new sales and 1,035 resales (1,511 purchases); new sales were 31.5% of these purchases. Subsales (70) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,035 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 631 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,035 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,205 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−14.1%). Planning-area private resales −17.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
